planets.name: TOI-3693 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-3693 with a 9.09-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-3693 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-3693. Its orbit and size follow Yee et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
